name: The north
text: Restaurants, marinas and calm lagoons. The island's liveliest coast.

name: The west
places: Tamarin · Black River · Flic en Flac
text: Sunsets, surf and the mountains behind. Popular with families.

name: The east
text: Long white beaches and a quieter pace.

name: The south
text: Wild coastline, golf and nature reserves.

name: The centre
text: Cooler hills, good schools and quick access to Port Louis.
